lines: Cyrus Jamshed Guzder, Investor Selling Shareholder, sells up to 132,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹17.85 crore, if all offered shares are sold, have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
That trigger is 248 days old, so it is no longer recent; the gain is up to ₹13.36 crore before expenses and taxes.
Holdings were found in one section only (promoter_holding), so confidence is medium; verify before the call.
